profile.name: HAS-TRAILING-SLASH-QUOTED-SCALAR-V1
profile.platform: Pinned Windows native profile only; Linux unqualified despite source-level separator analysis.
profile.syntax: ASCII case-insensitive whole identifier HasTrailingSlash immediately followed by exactly one single-quoted argument; existing surrounding whitespace/group/And/Or grammar. Delimiter spelling, raw malformed grammar and raw simple property-reference validation remain bounded.
profile.rawArgument: Ordinary quoted XML scalar text, including Unicode, whitespace, punctuation, URI/drive-shaped text and percent escapes, interleaved with existing simple ASCII-identifier property references. Existing item/metadata/static property-function prerequisite refusals remain; no new ASCII-only scalar refusal.
profile.expandedArgument: At reached evaluation only: one-pass current property expansion; split on raw semicolons (macros excluded), trim each token using the existing captured .NET whitespace set, discard empty tokens; zero tokens -> empty/false, multiple tokens -> private CONDITION_PROFILE/native scalar boundary, one token -> decode valid %XX exactly once while preserving invalid percent text; test final slash/backslash. Never trim/split/expand again after decoding. Expanded quotes/operators/parentheses are data and never reparsed.
profile.scalarNotPath: Windows scalar conversion trims/splits/unescapes lexical data only. No path resolution, containment, normalization or filesystem reads. MaybeAdjustFilePath is no-op on Windows; Linux is unqualified.
profile.null: XML has no null argument value. Empty and undefined-property expansion are covered. Literal 'null' is ordinary text. Native API null values and Java null map entries are not qualified by this slice; do not invent an equivalence.
profile.unsupported: Existing macro/item/metadata/static property-function prerequisites, raw grammar outside selected single-quoted function form, unary !, !=, general functions and new coercions remain outside scope. Linux qualification remains open. Ordinary scalar Unicode/whitespace/punctuation and native percent token conversion are supported by this slice.
profile.validation: Validate raw syntax/simple references throughout skipped XML without warming cache or warning. Do not use historical blanket unescape/ASCII condition-template validation for the new typed predicate argument. Reached scalar conversion handles tokenization/unescape locally; shared equality/Exists/assignment behavior stays unchanged. Expanded text is data, with existing macro prerequisite rejection preserved.
profile.cache: Add immutable typed predicate node holding raw argument only. Count one AST node. Exact entire raw condition remains cache key. No State/globals/value/path/result retained. Existing 64-group/256-node/3000-threshold restrictions and warning-first-reached-parse semantics remain unchanged.
profile.api: No exports/opens, new public API or dependency. Keep package-private ProjectEvaluationComponent and existing Result interface. Predicate node/helper are private implementation details.
dataflow: Secured DOM and SourceIndex retain existing structure/site identity.
